title: Tencent Hunyuan open sourced HY-Motion 1.0 (text-to-motion model)
author: Zinlencer
selftext:
From their announcement post:

>Tencent HY-Motion 1.0, a billion-parameter text-to-motion model built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture and flow matching. Tencent HY-Motion 1.0 empowers developers and individual creators alike by transforming natural language into high-fidelity, fluid, and diverse 3D character animations, delivering exceptional instruction-following capabilities across a broad range of categories. The generated 3D animation assets can be seamlessly integrated into typical 3D animation pipelines.

Project Page: [https://hunyuan.tencent.com/motion](https://t.co/IIGGQj25Pg)
